name: Veggie Omelette
method: Slice the mushrooms and halve the tomatoes. Beat the eggs in a jug with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry the mushrooms and tomatoes for 3 minutes, then add the spinach for 1 minute until wilted.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until just set, then fold in half and serve.
